(335)༄༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi nyams len ye shes rang gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (335)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi nyams len ye shes rang gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(336)༄༅// na mo gu ra be/ su kha sid+dhi rā hu la/ brgyud nas brgyud par byin brlabs pa// lha bzhi'i zhabs la btud nas 'dir// rgyun gyi nyams len khyer bde 'chad// 'di nyid kyi bka' dang khrid rim thob pa'i skal pa can dag gis nyams len snying por dril ba ni 'di lta ste// sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi// rjes so// dang po ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ste// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam lha bzhi dril sgrub nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed bzlas dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang len pa'o// dang po ni/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa// rdo rje'i srung 'khor me phung 'bar ba'i dbus// rang nyid dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku// gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung bde ba che// phyi dkar nang dmar 'od kyi rang bzhin dbus// pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi zla'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan yongs su gyur// bla ma(337)rdo rje 'chang chen nam mkha'i mdangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rang 'od dbyings phyug gri thod 'dzin mar 'khyud// dar dang rus pa rin po che yis brgyan pa// byin rlabs ye shes 'od zer mu med klong*// rdo rje'i skyil mo gung gis bzhugs pa'o// de mdun nyi mar tshogs bdag bskyel ba'i gdan// hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las// ye shes mgon po zhal gcig phyag drug pa// char sprin mdog can spyan gsum mche bzhi gtsigs// smar smin dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu 'bar// g.yas gsum gri gug thod phreng ḍā ma ru// g.yon gsum thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa bsnams// thod pa skam rlon rus pa sprul rigs dang*// li khri'i thig le dril bu g.yer khas brgyan// spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal po'i cod pan mdzes// glang ko'i stod g.yogs stag lpags sham thabs can// me phung dbus na bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis rol// g.yas su nyi steng hrīḥdamar gri gug hrīḥs// mtshan pa yongs gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/

(338)dmar mo gzhon tshul zhal 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams// spyan gsum g.yon gzigs lcang lo sil bur 'phyangs// phyag g.yas gri gug zur sdigs g.yon pa yis// bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa steng nas gsol// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyang phyag rgya lnga yis spras// g.yas brkyang stabs kyis 'jigs dus mnan pa'o// rgyab tu zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥyig las// pad dkar hrīḥs mtshan yongs gyur spyan ras gzigs// dkar gsal phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin bum pas mtshan// g.yon pas pad dkar sdong bu thugs kar bsnams// dbu skra sil bu 'od dpag med pas brgyan// zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum stabs kyis bzhugs// g.yon phyogs zla steng tāṃ las ut+pa la// tāṃ mtshan yongs gyur ār+ya tā re ljang*// bcu drug sgeg nyams don grub dbu rgyan can// g.yas g.yon skyabs sbyin ut+pal rab rgyas 'dzin// rgyan ldan g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pas 'gying*// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rtsa gsum dkon mchog gsum// bla ma lha bzhi'i rnam par spyan drangs thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥskyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// bla ma rin po che lha bzhi'i tshogs la bdag gis phyi me tog bdug spos// nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes// yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing mnyes par bgyi'o// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byin rlabs ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo// dngos grub ma lus thob pa'i gnas// bar chad ma lus sel ba'i lha// bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la 'dud/ /dam pa kha cig gis mchod bstod 'di'i tshab tu yan lag bdun (339) pa dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'ang bzhed// de nas dbus kyi bla ma la dmigs pa'i mos gus bcas/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badz+ra bī ra bī ra ṇī/

shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ka dzo ki nī/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā ya sha ra ṇi gats+tsha mi kyai/ zhes bzlas/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad dag /bla ma'i gsang gsum byin rlabs thob par gyur/ mdun gyi mgon po la dmigs te/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bi gh+naṃ bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ /mgon po'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nang gdon bar chad dag /mgon po'i gsang gsum byin rlabs thob par gyur/ /g.yas kyi rnal 'byor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kraṃ kraṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla ba ni yig rnying gi dngos bstan yin la/ phyis kyi phyag len kha cig tu 'di la oṃ gsum ma bzla bar gsungs/ /rnal 'byor ma las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad dag /phag mo'i gsang gsum byin rlabs thob par gyur/ rgyab kyi spyan ras gzigs la dmigs te/ oṃ ma ni pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa na maḥs man+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ /'phags pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad dag /'phags pa'i gsang gsum byin rlabs thob par gyur/ /g.yon gyi sgrol ma la dmigs te/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla/ /sgrol ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad dag /sgrol ma'i gsang gsum byin rlabs thob par gyur/ /'di'i bsnyen pa ched du byed na/ na mo bud+dha cung zad mang ba dang*/ gzhan bzhi po cha snyoms nas bzla/

(340) mgon po'i bsnyen pa'i thog mar 'di nyid btang skabs mgon bsnyen nyid bungs bskyed par gsungs pa dang*/ khrid rgyun tu rnal 'byor ma'i oṃ gsum ma gtso bor bzla bar gsungs pa de ngag gi rnal 'byor gtsor bton pa la dgongs par mngon zhing*/ 'dir rgyun gyi bzlas par brgya'am bdun la sogs pa cha snyoms pa kho na bzla ba dang*// spros pas mi lcogs pa'i skabs su so so'i dmigs pa'i tshigs bcad rnams dor te bstod pa'i rjes kho nar sngags rnams tshar gsum gsum bzla ba'i tshe/ /bla ma lha las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad dag /bla ma lha bzhi'i gsang gsum byin thob gyur/ /zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyas bsdus gang ltar bzlas bsgom grub pa'i thun mthar sngags tshan lnga spel ba'am/ na mo bud+dha lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros// lha bzhi tshur bsdus spyi bor spyan ras gzigs// mgrin par sgrol ma thugs kar nag po che// lte bar rnal 'byor ma bzhugs slar yang 'od// phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs te// bla ma'i sku las yongs su gtams par gyur/ 'og rlung bskum/ rlung bum can nam bar rlung bzung la/ /gsang gnas rlung g.yos lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar// tshangs bug nas thon chos 'byung dros pa yis// bla ma'i skur phog lha rnams bde bar zhu// bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung rang gi spyi bo nas/ mgrin pa yan gang lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob sku yi byin rlabs zhugs// snying ga yan gang ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs// lte ba yan gang yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab dbang thob thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs// lus kun gang bas sgo gsum sdig sgrib dag /bzhi pa'i dbang thob byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs// chos 'byung 'od yal bla ma rang la thim// sgo gsum rdo rje (341)gsum dang dbyer med gyur/

/gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med du 'dres de ka'i rang ngo la bzo bcos dgag sgrub med par rang ngo shes tsam gyi ngang ci gnas su bskyang ngo*/ gnyis pa ni/ de las ldangs pa na shes bzhin gyi dran pa'i rang so ma nyams par/ kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// bdag gi dge ba 'dis thob ste// 'gro kun gyis kyang thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa// byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi// spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab ste spyod lam la 'jug go /gegs sel bogs 'don mchog dngos kyi// grub pa lo zlas ster byed pa// ches zab rnal 'byor 'di bsgoms nas// zhing rdul snyed kyi 'gro sgrol shog/ /ces pa'ang yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling gi sgrub la gzhol ba rnams kyi nyams bzhes nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bla ma'i gsung rgyun bzhin bris pa dge legs 'phel// (342)
